headline: Bitcoin slid to about $75,600 on Thursday as chip and AI stocks crashed, wiping out leveraged bets, while the fallout from the $6.3B Binance hack reached US bank regulators.

stories.title: Bitcoin slides toward $75,500 as chip stocks crash
stories.summary: Wednesday's post-election bounce reversed on Thursday. Chip and AI stocks fell hard after the US open and bitcoin dropped more than 5%, moving in step with the Nasdaq. Traders who had borrowed to bet on higher prices were forced out, which made the drop faster.
points: Bitcoin fell from above $80,800 to near $76,100 within about two hours of the US open, per Bitcoin Magazine.
CoinGecko showed bitcoin at $76,133.86, down 5.4% over 24 hours, with a 24-hour low of $75,572.68.

Liquidation counts differ: crypto.news, citing CoinGlass, reports $1.08B in 24 hours ($954M of it longs); TheStreet, also citing CoinGlass, reports $878M in 4 hours; Bitcoin Magazine says about $370M in roughly an hour.
Crypto stocks fell with it, per 24/7 Wall St: Coinbase down 10% to $135.93, Strategy down 10% to $128.54 and Circle down 12% to $67.25.
The chip index fell about 10% and the S&P 500 was on pace for its worst day since the April 2025 tariff selloff, per Yahoo Finance.

stories.title: Binance hack fallout: US bank regulators step in as Binance asks Arbitrum and Polygon to return frozen funds
stories.summary: After the roughly $6.3B theft from Binance on 29 Oct, US bank regulators began asking banks about suspicious transactions, according to a Reuters report. Binance is also asking blockchain communities to release stolen funds that were frozen.
points: The Fed and the OCC began contacting US banks on 2 Nov about suspicious transactions and cyber weaknesses, per Bitcoin.com News, summarizing Reuters.
Binance asked Arbitrum's DAO to release 8,425.997 ETH and 74.56M ARB that were frozen, in a process of about 49 days or more, per crypto.news.
A Polygon proposal would hard-fork to move 70.49M POL (46.63M linked to Binance, 23.86M to Polymarket) to recovery wallets; Cointelegraph values it at about $6.8M.
The proposal was discussed on Polygon's governance call on Thursday; no outcome had been reported when this page was updated.

stories.title: Democrats' Congress puts the crypto market-structure bill on hold
stories.summary: With Democrats set to control both chambers of Congress, analysts expect the main crypto market-structure bill to stall and more investigations of crypto firms. House Democrats are discussing their own bill that would give the SEC a bigger role.
points: Stifel's Brian Gardner said the CLARITY Act is off the table for the lame-duck session and expects investigations of crypto firms, per 24/7 Wall St.
House Democrats are discussing turning Rep. Maxine Waters' crypto investor bill of rights into a full market-structure bill with more SEC oversight and ethics limits on officials, per Decrypt.
Democrats plan to look into the Trump family's crypto ventures, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Circle's quarterly beat leaned on a one-off
briefs.summary: Circle earned $0.84 a share vs $0.38 expected, but a $182M Arc token presale drove most of it; USDC supply was flat at $73.9B, per 24/7 Wall St.

briefs.title: Riot signs a 15-year AI data center lease
briefs.summary: Riot disclosed a 15-year lease of 910 MW at its Corsicana campus to an unnamed AI lab, in its third-quarter release filed with the SEC.

briefs.title: ETF flows turned positive on 4 Nov
briefs.summary: Bitcoin ETFs took in $74.6M and ether funds $53M on Wednesday, before Thursday's selloff; Fidelity's FBTC led with about $237M while BlackRock's IBIT lost $201.2M, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa resumes operations
briefs.summary: The French bank says customer funds were unaffected; ZachXBT puts suspected stolen crypto above $133M, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: France drops stablecoin tax plans
briefs.summary: The National Assembly rejected the revenue section of the 2027 budget, so crypto amendments fell out of the version sent to the Senate, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: South Korea moves to delay its crypto tax to 2029
briefs.summary: The plan would postpone a 22% tax on yearly crypto gains above 2.5M won by another two years, its fourth delay, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Arkansas sues Kalshi
briefs.summary: Arkansas's attorney general sued the prediction market over its sports event contracts, per Decrypt.
